title: The title was a little too accurate #disenchantment #disney #moviemus...
transcript: so I watched Disenchanted last night and I'm not gonna lie I was a little bored and maybe it was the frame of mind I was in honestly I was gonna rewatch it today but my Disney Plus subscription just ran out literally overnight so um that's not happening but it just felt like all of the humor that was there in the first one was just kind of missing from this this one villains are fun and campy and I felt like this movie could have leaned a lot more into that and it just didn't that being said as a stepchild the ending definitely got to me I cried it was emotional but the journey there was just kind of meh I also didn't really love the songs and I did listen to the soundtrack again this morning and none of none of the songs have like stuck in my head I definitely think the most memorable song is Love Power but every time I try to remember it I just sing Show Yourself so I don't think it was awful but overall it was a miss for me and I feel like I'm just gonna forget this movie even exist in a couple days let me know if you seen it what did you think
